description: Put a practice exam score in context. For each of the signed-in family's children, compares their EduAvenues TJ practice exam scores with other real EduAvenues TJ students on the same exam (typical score, middle half, and roughly where the child sits), shows the child's own trend across exams, and shows where students who scored like this on an earlier exam were on a later one. Use it when a parent worries about a low practice exam score ("is 50% normal?"). Any comparison with fewer than 10 students is withheld. These are practice exam results, not official scores, and never an admission prediction.

student.description: Optional first name of one of the family's own children
